name: TAFE SA Fee Free TAFE Incidental Costs Scholarship
summary: Up to $185 towards equipment, clothing and other incidental costs for concession card holders in hardship doing a TAFE SA Fee Free course.
key: You can apply for up to $185.00 for incidental costs associated with a FFT course over the life of the course.
who: Currently enrolled in a Fee Free course with TAFE SA
how: Apply online within the semester that you will pay for the incidental cost.
catches: Funding is limited, so approval depends on available funds.
Total claims for one qualification can't exceed $185.
